summary: Find commitments, unanswered follow-ups, ownership gaps, and conflicting status across the systems where work happened.

useCases.title: Find work that is slipping
useCases.message: Check the relevant meetings, messages, tasks, and project records for open commitments, missing owners, and conflicting status, then recommend the smallest next actions.

useCases.title: Close important follow-ups
useCases.message: Help me find important promises, decisions, and follow-ups that have not been completed or recorded properly.

useCases.title: Find product and engineering work that is slipping
useCases.message: Reconcile our product and engineering commitments across meetings, messages, tickets, and project records, then show missing owners, conflicting status, and the smallest next actions.

useCases.title: Audit open commitments
useCases.message: Reconcile recent commitments across the sources I provide and show me what is still open, unclear, or waiting on someone.
